title: CarPlay Arrives at the Helm: Crest Marine and Balise Pontoons Partner With Savvy Navvy on Industry First
summary: Collaboration delivers industry’s first Apple CarPlay Android Auto with on-water navigation straight from the factory. Crest and Balise Pontoons, MasterCraft Boat Holdings’ premier pontoon brands, today announced a partnership with Savvy Navvy, the leading all-in-one marine navigation app. Mirroring an automotive infotainment experience already familiar to consumers, Crest and Balise boaters now have access to Apple CarPlay and Android Auto featuring Savvy Navvy’s industry-leading, on-water navigation. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260804925738/en/ Savvy Navvy navigation displayed through Apple CarPlay at the helm of a Crest pontoon, delivering seamless on-water navigation and route planning.
